🐾 UPDATE 6: PETS ARE HERE! 🐾

🚀 Welcome to +1 Speed Wings Escape!
⚡ Every step gives you +1 speed! Jump from island to island across the ocean, dodge lasers and DON'T fall into the water! 🌊
❄️ NEW: unlock the frozen World 2 at level 35 and join the live Race to win big rewards! 🏁

⭐ What you do:
▪ Earn wins and upgrade your wings 🪽
▪ Fly further to reach the last island 🛫
▪ Equip auras that boost your wins ✨
▪ Collect colorful trails 🌈
▪ Rebirth and climb the leaderboards 🏆
▪ Race other players to the finish!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for new islands every update!

#Obby #SpeedObby #WingsObby #Plus1Speed #KeyboardObby #IslandObby #EscapeObby
